text:
Alex S.: Kicking off POC with CurrencyFlow. They need streaming SDK + function/tool calling to enrich transactions with live FX lookups (structured JSON outputs). Customer will be on VPC + SAML SSO. Quick asks: 1) Node/Go sample for streaming + function calls, 2) how function outputs map to structured output in the SDK, 3) pricing ballpark for ~1M tokens/month with 500 qps peak. Timeline: 3 weeks. Any enterprise blockers? :rocket:

Maria E.: @Alex S. can you paste the customer's contact + whether they require full on-prem vs just VPC? Also confirm KMS/HSM requirement and retention rules.

Jon P.: Quick answers up front: streaming + function/tool calls supported, and function_call results come back as structured JSON you can parse from the SDK event stream. For Node, minimal example (streaming + function call):
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = client.responses.stream({
  model: 'redwood-infer-pro-v1',
  input: 'Fetch FX rate for EUR->USD, attach to txn',
  stream: true,
  functions: [{ name: 'fx_lookup', parameters: { type: 'object', properties: { pair: { type: 'string' } } } }],
  function_call: 'auto'
});
for await (const evt of stream) {
  if (evt.type === 'function_call') {
    // evt.payload is structured JSON from the tool
    const fx = JSON.parse(evt.payload);
    // attach to txn, etc.
  }
  if (evt.type === 'delta') { process.stdout.write(evt.chunk); }
}
```
Notes: use redwood-infer-pro-v1 for hosted; for Private deployments we recommend the quantized variant (redwood-infer-pro-q4) for cost/throughput. SDK streaming yields function_call events in the order they were emitted; you can treat them as atomic structured responses.

Sam C.: For pricing, rough hosted on-demand estimate: ~ $0.02 per 1k tokens (example), so 1M tokens ~= $20/month before qps considerations. For 500 qps steady peak you'll likely need Dedicated/reserved capacity — ballpark committed monthly contract (~$7k-$12k/mo) depending on model and latency SLOs. I'll get an exact quote once we know model choice and retention. Dedicated gives predictable p95 latency and avoids throttles.

Alex S.: Important: customer requires SAML SSO + IP allowlist + retention 30 days. They prefer Dedicated but want to know fallback behavior if reserved pool is saturated.

Jon P.: Fallback policy: yes — you can set routing policy to prefer Dedicated and fallback to hosted-compatible model variants. Example route snippet (console/terraform):
```yaml
routing_policy:
  - priority: dedicated
    match: customer_id == "currencyflow"
  - priority: hosted
    match: region == "us-west-2"
    fallback: true
```
When falling back we translate function calls to the hosted model variant; watch out for KMS differences (on Dedicated/Private you can use customer KMS, hosted uses RW-managed keys unless you configure BYOK).

SecurityBot: Uploaded: https://redwood.internal/secure/questionnaires/CurrencyFlow_SecQ_494321.pdf and SOC2 summary. Also: please fill out SAML attribute map and contact info for IDP. IP allowlist template: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/ip-allowlist-template.md

Maria E.: I'll consolidate the docs + ask the customer for the IDP metadata and KMS requirement. @Sam C. can you prepare two pricing options: Hosted on-demand and Dedicated 3-month commit? Also include expedited onboarding cost if they want 2-week timeline.

Sam C.: Yep — I'll run numbers and post a short slide. One note: if they require HSM-backed KMS for Private, add a ~20% uplift on infra fees (vendor dependent).

Jon P.: Two engineering gotchas to flag for the POC: 1) If the tool (fx_lookup) makes outbound network calls from Private/VPC, we need explicit egress rules or an adaptor; 2) For structured outputs, include an explicit JSON schema in the functions.parameters to avoid partial/ambiguous results. Example function declaration:```json
{ "name": "fx_lookup", "parameters": { "type": "object", "properties": { "pair": { "type": "string" }, "rate": { "type": "number" }, "ts": { "type": "string", "format": "date-time" } }, "required": ["pair","rate"] } }
```

Alex S.: Good call. Also: what's the recommended token limit for these fx enrichment calls? We want predictable latency.

Jon P.: Keep prompt+context <= 1k tokens per request for p95 under 200ms on dedicated GPUs for that model. If you need longer history, enable KV caching/prefix caching on the SDK to reuse embeddings & reduce token footprint.

Maria E.: I'll draft the kickoff email to customer with: IDP metadata request, KMS question, sample Node snippet, and ask if they want Dedicated quote. Will send in ~30m.

Alex S.: Perfect — timeline: email now, get IDP metadata within 48h, run a short demo week 1. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Jon P.: Opening an internal runbook ticket to provision trial dedicated capacity and a fallback hosted route (tracking id: RW-POC-8942).

Sam C.: I'll attach preliminary pricing deck to the thread once ready.

Maria E.: Closing loop after customer reply. Thanks team! :rocket:
